commonAcceptance: Implement the exact proposed core mechanic as causal gameplay. Reskinned generic selection, arithmetic, resource adjustment or path puzzles do not satisfy distinct game proposals.

Mobile-first Traditional Chinese interface, visible objective/state/legal controls/feedback, accessible labels and practical keyboard alternatives. Actual browser geometry must pass 333px, 400px and desktop widths, including open select menus, help and long log text.

All proposals support objective missions in principle. Default to 100 selectable, meaningfully varied missions per game with stable IDs. A freeform-only exception needs a concrete mechanic-specific explanation and must not evade feasible objective missions; additional freeform mode is welcome.

For every levelBased game: exactly 100 levels. Structural and task diversity must exceed changes in names, labels, palette, symmetry, harmless seed data or irrelevant numeric fields. Provide a semantic fingerprint and distinctness rationale based on fields consumed by the engine.

Every solvability claim has nonempty legal action/input witnesses executed through the same runtime engine and independent terminal/property assertions. UI controls must be able to express every witness action, range, timing and rate from the exact published start state. Reject illegal, truncated, empty and corrupted traces.

Hints and demonstrations run legal transitions, remain contextual, and mark results assisted. They must not overwrite unassisted completion, scores or records; save/reload keeps assistance status. A demo shortcut is not evidence that a user can play the mission.

Challenge claims distinguish reachability, deterministic policy scenarios, physical timing traces and adversarial forced wins. Do not claim uniqueness, arbitrary-opponent wins, realistic scientific simulation or unrestricted narrative intelligence without corresponding evidence.

Where AI is appropriate, implement real local state-dependent decisions with easy/normal/hard modes. Test legal actions, permitted observations, causal reaction to changed visible state and meaningful policy/skill differences. Hidden cards, latent traits, unrevealed events and player secret orders cannot leak into decisions.

Seeded challenge policies may be fixed for proof, but AI difficulty controls must be usable and their scope clear. A timer, random move, canned answer transcript or level difficulty dropdown alone is not AI.
Reset, level/difficulty/mode change, navigation, pause and repeated input cancel stale timers, pending AI and demos. Validate local persistence per game and guard malformed/missing saved data.

No external AI/API, accounts, network multiplayer claim, external fonts/media or runtime dependency. Audio, when used, starts only after user gesture and has mute control; all objectives remain perceivable without sound.

Supply mechanic-specific fresh artwork for each game, exact title, accurate Traditional Chinese instructions and README. README covers exact abstraction, objective, controls, proof scope, AI observations/difficulty and known limits.

Run verifier and controller tests against exact final engine/controller/corpus/test bytes. Reports bind sources before execution and verify unchanged afterward. Keep engine tests, simulated DOM, real browser and hosted QA claims separate.
